title: Field Service Dispatch, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Field Service Dispatch agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Field Service Dispatch Technicians list.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Carlos Rivera (TechnicianId TECH-201), with Zone West.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Field Service Dispatch Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 3 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Field Operations Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What critical Central request is unassigned right now?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Emergency: SCADA communication failure; CRITICAL; No job. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Service Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Compare Central zone load and capacity before anyone is rerouted.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Central; 3; dispatcher must validate. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Dispatch Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Who is the best certified candidate for SR-4005? Do not assign them.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Marcus Thompson; Candidate for dispatcher review; No technician has been assigned. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Emergency Duty Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft the SR-4005 response view without dispatching or notifying anyone.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Emergency Response Draft; Marcus Thompson; No field action. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Field Service Dispatch: 3 read-only tabs from the same lists. 5 fictional records, including Carlos Rivera (TechnicianId TECH-201), with Zone West.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Field Service Dispatch Technicians from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload technicians.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set TechnicianId, Certifications, Zone, Status, CurrentLocation to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep JobsToday, MaxJobs, EfficiencyRating, YearsExperience as Number. Name the list Field Service Dispatch Technicians. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Carlos Rivera (TechnicianId TECH-201), with Zone West.

steps.title: Create Field Service Dispatch Service Requests from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload service-requests.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ServiceRequestId, Priority, Type, RequiredCerts, Zone, Location, Equipment, Status to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep EstimatedHours as Number. Name the list Field Service Dispatch Service Requests. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Transformer oil leak - Ridgeline Substation (ServiceRequestId SR-4001), with Priority high.

steps.title: Create Field Service Dispatch Geographic Zones from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload geographic-zones.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set GeographicZoneId, States to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Technicians, OpenRequests as Number. Name the list Field Service Dispatch Geographic Zones. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including West (GeographicZoneId West), with Technicians 2.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Field Service D Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there.
steps.expected: The studio instructions name the 3 list tools and map every Title and field_N column.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload field-service-dispatch-rules-and-controls.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the technicians tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Field Service Dispatch Technicians; name the tool Get technician records.
steps.expected: Get technician records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the service requests tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Field Service Dispatch Service Requests; name the tool Get service request records.
steps.expected: Get service request records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the geographic zones tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Field Service Dispatch Geographic Zones; name the tool Get geographic zone records.
steps.expected: Get geographic zone records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 3 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 3 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Field Operations Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What critical Central request is unassigned right now?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Emergency: SCADA communication failure; CRITICAL; No job. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Service Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Compare Central zone load and capacity before anyone is rerouted.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Central; 3; dispatcher must validate. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Dispatch Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Who is the best certified candidate for SR-4005? Do not assign them.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Marcus Thompson; Candidate for dispatcher review; No technician has been assigned. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Emergency Duty Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft the SR-4005 response view without dispatching or notifying anyone.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Emergency Response Draft; Marcus Thompson; No field action. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: field-service-dispatch-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 3 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Field Service Dispatch Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Field Service Dispatch Technicians" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Field Service Dispatch Service Requests" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Field Service Dispatch Geographic Zones" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Field Service Dispatch Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Field Service Dispatch Technicians tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 5 fictional records, including Carlos Rivera (TechnicianId TECH-201), with Zone West.
